## Summary

I resolved ticket T-2005 by identifying that the ledger-export CronJob was being terminated due to an insufficient `activeDeadlineSeconds` timeout. The job was processing 95 batches at ~8-9 minutes per batch, requiring 2-3 hours to complete, but the deadline was set to only 1 hour. The fix is to increase the activeDeadlineSeconds value in the CronJob spec to allow the job more time to finish its work before the next scheduled run.
